title: Bram and the Parish
author: Rosalind Nakamura
blurb: Rosalind Whitlock, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
